endpoints.summary: Affinity maturation: per-position mutation scan of an existing antibody.
endpoints.description:
Affinity maturation: per-position mutation scan of an existing antibody.

Requires fasta_origin (the original sequence to mature from).

request_fields.name: epitope
request_fields.description: Antigen interface residue numbers (1-based). If omitted, IgGM's cal_ppi infers the epitope from the complex structure when possible. Get one from POST /api/epitope.

request_fields.name: steps
request_fields.description: Number of sampling steps (upstream default 10; 200 is the internal full schedule).

request_fields.name: num_samples
request_fields.description: Number of maturation rounds. Total outputs scale as num_samples x masked positions x (chains-1); keep modest on FC and use the CLI/Slurm mode for large sweeps.

request_fields.name: chunk_size
request_fields.description: Chunk size for long-chain inference (memory/speed tradeoff).

request_fields.name: temperature
request_fields.description: Sampling temperature.

request_fields.name: max_antigen_size
request_fields.description: Truncate the antigen chain to this many residues to avoid OOM. Upstream suggests 384 for large antigens.

request_fields.name: seed
request_fields.description: Random seed. If omitted, the upstream default (42) is used.
request_fields.default_note: random seed selected by the tool at runtime

examples.title: affinity maturation
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/affinity-maturation -F fasta=@ab_CDR_H3.fasta -F antigen=@antigen.pdb -F fasta_origin=@ab_native.fasta -F num_samples=10
examples.notes: Requires fasta_origin. Output count scales with num_samples x masked positions.

endpoints.description:
Antibody design: CDR sequence + structure co-design (design), sequence
on a fixed backbone (inverse_design), or framework-region redesign
(fr_design), selected via run_task.

request_fields.name: epitope
request_fields.description: Antigen interface residue numbers (1-based). If omitted, IgGM's cal_ppi infers the epitope from the complex structure when possible. Get one from POST /api/epitope.

request_fields.name: steps
request_fields.description: Number of sampling steps (upstream default 10; 200 is the internal full schedule).

request_fields.name: num_samples
request_fields.description: Number of designs to generate.

request_fields.name: chunk_size
request_fields.description: Chunk size for long-chain inference (memory/speed tradeoff).

request_fields.name: temperature
request_fields.description: Sampling temperature.

request_fields.name: max_antigen_size
request_fields.description: Truncate the antigen chain to this many residues to avoid OOM. Upstream suggests 384 for large antigens.

request_fields.name: seed
request_fields.description: Random seed. If omitted, the upstream default (42) is used.
request_fields.default_note: random seed selected by the tool at runtime

request_fields.name: run_task
request_fields.description: design = CDR sequence + full complex structure co-design; inverse_design = sequence design on a fixed backbone (FASTA only); fr_design = framework-region redesign (humanization).

examples.notes: fasta has 'X' at the CDR to design; antigen chain id matches the last FASTA record. Poll /api/jobs/<id>, then GET /api/jobs/<id>/download.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: IgGM
model.paper: Wang et al. ICLR 2025 + bioRxiv 2025.09.12.675771 (generative foundation model for antibody design)
model.output_format: complex PDB + designed-sequence FASTA (inverse_design: FASTA only)

tool_outputs.design: output/<name>_<i>.pdb (antibody-antigen complex) + output/<name>_<i>.fasta (designed sequence), one per sample. inverse_design emits FASTA only.
tool_outputs.affinity-maturation: output/<id>_<pos>_<n>.{pdb,fasta} — many candidates; count = num_samples x masked positions.
tool_outputs.epitope: output/epitope.json — {epitope: [residue numbers (1-based)], antigen_id, antigen_length}. Feed epitope back into /api/design.

input_spec.fasta: 1-3 chains, antigen LAST; 'X' marks residues to design. 2 chains = nanobody (H,A); 3 = antibody (H,L,A).
input_spec.antigen: antigen structure as PDB (chain id must match the last FASTA record).
input_spec.fasta_origin: affinity-maturation only: the original antibody sequence to mature from.

config_tips.epitope: Optional JSON-encoded int list, e.g. epitope=[7,8,9]. If omitted, cal_ppi infers it from the complex structure. Precompute with POST /api/epitope.
config_tips.max_antigen_size: Set 384 for large antigens to avoid OOM.
config_tips.num_samples: affinity-maturation output scales as num_samples x masked positions; keep modest on FC.
